amends: Global pressure-change estimand only; original pressure thresholds and level/change weights are unchanged.
training_policy: All verified matches strictly before January 1 of prediction year; both innings remain together. No 2022 player residuals or ranking evidence.
level: Recency-weighted mean cross-fitted contribution on all pressure opportunities; shrink by effective pressure count / (effective pressure count + role pseudo events). Ordinary controls are not required.
change: Within-player pressure-minus-ordinary contribution in the intersection of peer-supported and player-supported same-year context cells, weighted by that player's recency-weighted pressure exposure in those cells. Never extrapolate to unsupported cells.
change_shrinkage: n_pair = 1 / sum_c(q_c^2 * (1/n_eff_pressure_c + 1/n_eff_ordinary_c)); multiply supported change by n_pair / (n_pair + role pseudo events). This is a fixed regularizer, not an estimated causal or posterior precision.
change_eligibility: Apply role pressure-event, pressure-match and effective-pressure minima again inside supported cells, plus ordinary minima there. No minimum fraction of all pressure exposure is imposed for this explicitly restricted estimand; always disclose that fraction.
missing_change: null, never zero; do not blend or rank with an unavailable change. Separate level-only evidence remains available.
blend_interpretation: Decision index combining all-pressure level and supported-context change with different populations. Not a global pressure effect. Identical eligible cohort for both variants.

targets.bowling_exposure: all delivery attempts; analytical rate, not official economy

expectation_model.first_candidate: Hierarchical shrunk historical peer means; player IDs and pressure flag excluded.
expectation_model.formula: Each child mean is (sum outcomes + prior_events * parent mean) / (events + prior_events); unseen cells use parent; global mean uses training only.
expectation_model.selection: Retain default for first baseline; report all five settings on three development folds. Freeze any promotion before opening reserved outcomes. Four folds times five registered settings is the maximum budget, each bundle predicts all four targets.
expectation_model.scale: Strict forecasting evaluation uses training-only outcome SD with floors 0.05 for runs and 0.01 for binary wickets. Final retrospective contribution uses a single frozen SD of 2023-2025 out-of-time residuals with those floors; no 2026 outcome enters reference scales.
expectation_model.advanced_models: Deferred until transparent baseline is validated; additional pre-ball score features require a versioned amendment.

bootstrap.support: Freeze supported cells and eligibility from the original evaluation population. Resample complete matches jointly across players and roles within each stratum; recompute weighted means and effective counts.
bootstrap.missing_group_in_draw: If any originally supported player cell loses either group, that player's change and blend are null in that draw. Never silently drop cells or renormalize to a different estimand.
bootstrap.interval: 10th-90th percentiles conditional on fitted expectations, eligibility and support; publish finite draw fraction. If fewer than 95% draws are finite, no selection score.

coverage_policy: Use source opportunities from the same date window and role denominator. Below 80% retention, show level/change diagnostics but block an unqualified shortlist; no automatic coverage override. Missing-source players are insufficient-evidence cases, not poor performers.
reserved_policy: Preflight may inspect dates, identities, pressure/support and exposure, not reserved performance. Aggregate 2026 EDA was previously seen. 2026 is reserved model evaluation, not pristine unseen data.
